00153 inline float zap(const float x) throw()
00154 {
00155     float absx = std::abs(x);
00156     return (absx > (float)1e-15 && absx < (float)1e15) ? x : 0.f;
00157 }

00159 inline double midicps(const int a) throw()          {   return 440.0 * ::pow(2.0, (a - 69.0) * oneOver12);              }

00162 inline double cpsmidi(const int a) throw()          {   return log2(a * oneOver440) * 12.0 + 69.0;                      }

00171 inline double besselI0(double p) throw()
00172 {
00173     static const int ITERLIMIT=15;
00174     static const double CONVERGE=1.0E-8;
00175     
00176     p = p/2;
00177     double n = 1, t = 1, d = 1;
00178     int k = 1;
00179     double v;
00180     
00181     do {
00182         n = n * p;           d = d * k;
00183         v = n / d;           t = t + v * v;
00184     } while ((++k < ITERLIMIT) && (v > CONVERGE));
00185     
00186     return t;
00187 }

00232 inline int roundFloatToInt (const float value) throw()
00233 {
00234     union { int asInt[2]; double asDouble; } n;
00235     n.asDouble = value + 6755399441055744.0;
00236     
00237     return n.asInt [0];

00241 inline double ceil(double a) throw()    { int n = (int)a; return (double)(n+1); }
00242 inline float ceil(float a) throw()      { int n = (int)a; return (float)(n+1); }
00243 inline double floor(double a) throw()   { int n = (int)a; return (double)n; }
00244 inline float floor(float a) throw()     { int n = (int)a; return (float)n; }
00245 inline double frac(double a) throw()    { int n = (int)a; return a - (double)n; }
00246 inline float frac(float a) throw()      { int n = (int)a; return a - (float)n; }
00247 inline double sign(double a) throw()    { int n = (a == 0.0) ? 0 : (a < 0.0) ? -1 : 1; return (double)n; }
00248 inline float sign(float a) throw()      { int n = (a == 0.f) ? 0 : (a < 0.f) ? -1 : 1; return (float)n; }
